notes: Your licence now decides whether the bot is installed at all. If it is missing, expired, revoked or for another machine, the bot is not installed and one already there is removed. Play normally never needs a licence. Skills for every class in the game, 19 rosters read from the game files, including Shinobi, Berserker and Gunslinger for the first time, and updates now carry new skills to you. Your own calibrated cooldowns are never overwritten. Setting the computer clock backwards no longer restores an expired licence. Module 1.60.0. Press Updates, then press Play with Helper once so the bot updates too.
